events.text: PLDT's combined 2025 Annual and Sustainability Report for the year ended December 31, 2025 integrates consolidated financial, environmental, social, and governance (ESG) information for PLDT and its subsidiaries and associates.
PLDT secured its first P1-billion green loan from HSBC.
Metrobank approved PLDT's P4-billion green loan, PLDT's second green loan overall and its first from a local financial institution.
PLDT took out P4 billion in green financing from Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co. to fund its network expansion.
After the Metrobank loan, PLDT's total green debt reached P5 billion.
On February 14, 2024, the Supreme Court First Division issued a decision in G.R. Nos. 244695, 244752 & 245294, Manggagawa sa Komunikasyon ng Pilipinas vs. PLDT, Inc.

A March 8, 2024 report said the Regional Director was ordered to review and properly determine the effects of the regularization of PLDT workers performing installation, repair, and maintenance services, and to compute the monetary award on the labor standards violation.
